### 2026-10-10 – Assigned footprints!!! YAY!!!

**2h**

Assigned footprints!!! YAY!!!
ok So for the first hour I finished the schematic and needed to assign the footprint things so I opened the window to do that and searched the names up but I couldn't find them. this screenshot is when I finished the first hour and was trying to find the things I needed

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 11.30.44 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RLfnF7qHkUwCrekQNa6pAHouKTonALg9/96fc8f3ec0e03ffbdf7ec4e5ec8d21c276beb8cf995aeb591568d5fef420e3c0.png)

 so I figured they probably need to be uploaded into kicad and I tried a lottt of different ways to upload it but none of them worked. I then searched up how to do it and after a lot of trial and error (literally an hour of trying to get the files onto kicad :sob:) I went to the main page and uploaded each file seperatly from the folder.
 I then opened my project in the schematic editor, opened assign footprint libraries, went to preferences, and clicked manage footprint libaries. I was then able to create a new one and a Google search told me that typing in the code   ${KIPRJMOD}   .  soo after I did that I went into the assign footprints thing and finally  got them all assigned!!!
after two hours:

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 12.50.50 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/RLfnF7qHkUwCrekQNa6pAHouKTonALg9/93d6f6e34b8e48e7235a7bc75fc80a53dd28fa83e1fb47151f079d7bc085dde6.png)
